Feature: Is there an overt marker for the absolutive?
curated_comment: Salish voice/focus system: transitive and intransitive clauses have different subject-marking strategies but not ergative alignment. The oblique marker ?s marks NPs in various semantic roles. S and A are aligned together in the control/subject position (nominative-accusative). All GB409 values = 0 are correct (Zahir 2018:§2.1-2.3).
